name: Gorse Bush
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const pulse=Math.sin(mt*0.5)*0.05; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ const gx=(i-3.5)*10 + Math.sin(i*1.3)*3; const gy=Math.sin(i*1.7)*8; svg += `<ellipse cx="${gx}" cy="${gy}" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#D4A020" opacity="${0.6+pulse}"/>`; svg += `<ellipse cx="${gx-2}" cy="${gy+1}" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#E0B030" opacity="${0.4+pulse}"/>`; } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
